fey-white.$description: Fey White — Primary text, decorative borders, hairlines — the dominant color of the system, used for typography and 554+ border occurrences

fey-ink.$description: Fey Ink — Primary canvas and card surfaces — the near-black that everything floats on

fey-charcoal.$description: Fey Charcoal — Elevated card surface, secondary panels — one step lighter than the canvas for nested depth

fey-obsidian.$description: Fey Obsidian — Tertiary surface, input backgrounds, subtle elevated layers

fey-graphite.$description: Fey Graphite — Muted secondary text, subdued borders, disabled labels — the workhorse mid-gray for everything that is not the headline

fey-mist.$description: Fey Mist — Icon strokes, subtle links, tertiary borders — a step brighter than Graphite for elements that need more presence

fey-smoke.$description: Fey Smoke — Deep dividers, shadow-tinted borders, very low-emphasis strokes

fey-pale.$description: Fey Pale — Subtle body borders, ghost button outlines, light strokes — the lightest non-white neutral

fey-ash.$description: Fey Ash — Low-emphasis borders and secondary text — sits between Graphite and Smoke

fey-ember.$description: Fey Ember — Warm accent for highlighted headline words and warm gradient terminus — orange-on-black reads as urgency and premium warmth; Warm hero gradient — Ember fading into deep brown for product showcase atmosphere

fey-signal.$description: Fey Signal — Navigation underline, active link border, cool accent — vivid blue draws the eye to current location and trust indicators

fey-growth.$description: Fey Growth — Green outline accent for tags, dividers, and focused UI edges. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

fey-abyss.$description: Fey Abyss — Shadow base color, deepest possible background — used in 0.8-opacity halos and gradient termini

fey-frost.$description: Fey Frost — Cool gradient accent — pale blue fading into slate for secondary product showcase

fey-volt.$description: Fey Volt — Highlight gradient — electric yellow-green fading into deep olive for standout elements

calibre.$description: The sole typeface — a geometric sans with slightly compressed proportions. Weight 400 carries body and most UI; 500–600 for nav and labels; 700 reserved for large display headlines. Tight tracking at -0.08em on 48–54px display creates the premium, compressed feel. Letter-spacing of -0.053em applies to mid-range headings. No secondary font family is used — Calibre does all roles from 10px captions to 54px heroes
